integrity: All stated infinite-domain identities have symbolic proofs; finite executable tests are auxiliary, and independent audit is absent.
scientific_limitations: The general sufficient dyadic threshold is not asserted to be sharp.
The two-factor collision probability uses stationary natural frequencies of starts, not uniformly selected distinct factors.
Historical priority against unpublished or unindexed sources is not certified.
title: Dyadic higher-Abelian profiles and an exact collision law for period-doubling factors
